news: New Chairman Shawn Pelsinger takes over effective July 24, 2026, following the annual shareholder meeting.
Debt refinancing cut convertible notes from ~$47M to $16.9M and added a $30M term loan plus a $21.6M aircraft-backed facility, easing near-term liquidity.
Wheels Up signed as launch customer for Enterprise BrokerOS (up to $12M subscription revenue); expanded Palantir SurfOS partnership. Still deeply unprofitable (margin under -100%, current ratio 0.2).
FY2026 earnings call set for July 27, 2026 (10 days away); market focus will be data-center utilization, contract expansion, and capex/funding plans.
Stock down ~50% since May on AI-capex and semiconductor-volatility concerns; Craig-Hallum reiterated a Buy rating on July 2.
Street stays Strong Buy despite the drawdown: 14 analysts, median target $74.50 (~125% implied upside).
Board added Andreas Lieber (ex-Uber/Postmates) as director, effective June 22, 2026.
Expanding beyond food delivery: NoScrubs laundry pilot launched in select LA neighborhoods; 'Moving Canvas' robot-as-public-art program debuted at Cannes Lions.
Analyst consensus remains Buy (8 analysts, $17.58 target) despite the stock down ~47% YTD and continued net losses.
FDA's PCAC panel reviews compounded GLP-1/peptide products July 23-24 - a binary regulatory catalyst for Hims' compounding-pharmacy revenue line.
BofA and Canaccord raised price targets to $36 and $40 respectively in early July on GLP-1 traction and a new $400M JPMorgan credit facility.
Reports Q2 FY26 earnings July 22, 2026 (5 days away); consensus calls for $3.92B revenue (+22% YoY) and $0.86 EPS.
New joint AI-powered cybersecurity offering launched with Accenture; Street 12-month average target implies ~26% upside.
AI-native platform adoption (Now Assist, Autonomous Workforce) cited as the key growth driver heading into the print.
S&P downgraded credit rating to BBB- on rising AI-data-center debt; stock ~64% off its September 2025 peak despite record FY26 results (cloud revenue +47%, cloud infrastructure +93%).
$0.50/share quarterly dividend pays July 24, 2026 (record date already passed).
Market is questioning whether the $638B AI backlog converts to cash fast enough to service the debt load; RSI now 27.4 (oversold).
